description: Play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) against AI directly in ChatGPT. Choose Red or Black, select Easy, Normal, or Hard, and play a complete game on a standard 9×10 board. Legal-move highlights, check alerts, captured pieces, undo, resign, and traditional Chinese and WXF move notation make every turn easy to follow. Games follow international Xiangqi rules, including the flying-general rule, checkmate, loss when no legal move remains, repetition and perpetual-check rulings, and the 60-move no-capture draw.
